items.rationale: Tren, tramvai and metrou share rail operation; bicicleta supplies an ordinary, unambiguous transport contrast. Fair easy board.
Ploaie, zăpadă and grindină are recognizable precipitation forms. Lup cannot satisfy that predicate; the easy contrast is honest.
Obraz, pleoapă and sprânceană belong to the face; genunchi belongs elsewhere on the body. No specialist definition is needed.
Coapsă, gambă and gleznă are lower-limb parts. Nas is a facial part; the label avoids falsely calling every member a joint.
Rădăcină, ramură and frunză are plant parts; piatră is not. Familiar words and a precise inclusive predicate support an easy round.
Canapea, fotoliu and taburet are intended for sitting; robinet is not furniture. Incidental uses do not create a competing ordinary answer.
Ciocan, clește and fierăstrău are ordinary manual workshop tools. Periuță de dinți is a familiar hygiene object rather than a fourth tool of that category.
Telemea, urdă and brânză de burduf offer recognizable Romanian food vocabulary. Caisă is a fruit; no regional exclusivity is claimed.
Amandină, ecler and savarină are familiar cofetărie cakes. Muștar is a condiment, with no credible second outsider under the label.
Compas, echer and raportor are school geometry instruments; mop is not. The common classroom association is precise and accessible.
Chiuvetă, cadă and robinet connect to household water. Ceas does not; the label avoids claiming all three are receptacles.
Mop, mătură and aspirator all clean floors despite different mechanisms. Stilou does not; the predicate does not require washing with water.
Lopată, greblă and stropitoare have familiar garden uses. Pastă de dinți is outside that function; different tool actions remain honestly grouped.
Urs, vulpe and veveriță are recognizable wild forest animals in Romania. Oaie is domestic; the claim does not imply exclusive forest habitat.
Vacă, cal and capră are domestic household animals; lup is wild. Familiarity and the domestic predicate make the solution stable.
Măr, pară and prună are ordinary orchard fruits. Morcov is a cultivated root; sweetness is not incorrectly used as the distinction.
Secundă, minut and oră measure duration. Riglă is an instrument for length, so the stated unit predicate remains exact.
Dulap, raft and comodă cu sertare store belongings. Șampon is a consumable; its container does not change the word's ordinary meaning.
Grâu, orz and ovăz are familiar cereals. Vanilie is not a cereal; culinary co-occurrence does not create ambiguity.
Nucă, alune de pădure and migdale fit the ordinary culinary hard-shell-kernel description. Cacao names a different ingredient, not a botanical nut claim.
Pantaloni, rochie and fustă are garments. Pieptene is for grooming rather than clothing; no gender stereotype is needed to solve the board.
Pătură, cearșaf and covor are household textiles. Ciocan is a tool; the label does not misleadingly restrict the group to bedding.
Acoperiș, perete and tavan are house construction elements. Motocicletă is a vehicle; everyday recognition suffices.
Tristețe, frică and furie are emotions, while foame signals a bodily need. The ordinary psychological distinction is defensible without hidden wordplay.
Soare, Lună and stea are celestial bodies; morcov is not. The label correctly permits the Sun to be a star without treating the Moon as one.
Cream preparation, washing/drying, bed support and bread leavening supply four clear relationships. Shared kitchen context does not yield another complete pairing.
Garcea's actor, clock/hour, pot/watering can and the cervid pair are recognizable and distinct. No adult framing is needed for the character association.
Sport, lighting, rail travel and Caragiale's comedy anchor separate pairs. The retained literary pair also appears in core history; this mixed board is not newly novel.
Salt/brine, grandparents, cutlery and Brâncuși/sculpture are concrete distinct links. None supplies a plausible exchange completing all four pairs.
Eminescu/poem, cheeses, eye-area parts and flour/dough have familiar separate explanations. The eye-area wording is narrower and more useful than generic body parts.
Siblings, two-wheel vehicles, hammer/nail and cloud/rain are distinct everyday links. Incidental transport or weather stories do not produce competing complete matches.
Heel/ankle, upholstered seating, Bobiță's actor and orchard fruits are independently recognizable. The television link requires no alcohol-dependent joke or stereotype.
Calendar/year, spouses, Halep's dated Wimbledon win and cereals have distinct anchors. The year makes the sports claim historical rather than a changing current ranking.
Sink/tap, book/reading, lightning/thunder and toothbrush/toothpaste are strong ordinary links. Water associations cannot replace both hygiene pairs coherently.
Precipitation, wheat/semolina, garments and culinary nuts form four distinct pairs. The grain-product relation avoids a misleading all-food category shortcut.
Line-drawing instruments, shoe/sock, bed/pillow and Creangă's story are familiar. No alternative use of a ruler supplies another full four-pair solution.
Parents, plug/socket, Porumbescu's composition and minute/second are distinct and recognizable. The time relation is exact rather than a vague shared theme.
Storage, hair care, plant watering and pancakes/jam separate cleanly. Water's other household uses leave the watering can unmatched rather than creating another complete solution.
Knife/bread, Slavici/novella, Neagu/handball and cocoa/chocolate have specific links. The literary pair is inherited core reuse, not a claim of a wholly new association.
Stove/pan, sarmale/cabbage, Coandă/effect and vacuum/dust are separable. Cabbage wrapping is a familiar variant, not every recipe; the historical Coandă pair is disclosed reuse.
Mămăligă/maize meal, shin/knee, mujdei/garlic and Piersic/Mărgelatu are distinct. Shared food preparation does not offer a credible replacement pairing.
Library/book, cup/tea, screwdriver/screw and oven/tray are concrete relationships. The specific heating vessel and beverage vessel remain easy to distinguish.
Notebook/pen, broom/dustpan, Enescu/rapsody and cakes are recognizable. Enescu's association is retained core history; the four-pair board has no competing complete arrangement.
Pencil/eraser, mop/bucket, mustard/mici and glass household objects are distinct. The familiar food pair is historical core reuse, without a claim that it is unique to Romania.
Glass/water, Racoviță/speleology, plant parts and Nadia's historical ten are fair. Two cultural pairs are retained core associations; no whole-board novelty is asserted.
Stilou, radieră and riglă are school supplies despite differing functions. Cană may be used at school but is not thereby a school supply.
Tigaie, oală and castron are kitchen vessels; cuțit cuts rather than contains food. All four remain in one familiar domain.
Camion, microbuz and dubă are road motor vehicles. Tren is rail transport; cargo versus passengers is not falsely made the deciding predicate.
Hen/egg, lamp/bulb, soup/spoon and airport/plane are specific everyday links. Culinary co-occurrence does not support a second complete matching.
Tooth/toothbrush, mop/floor, tree/root and shopping/shop have concrete roles. Different cleaning targets do not form a credible exchange between pairs.
School/learning, carrot/rabbit, clock/minute and flower/pot are familiar. The rabbit link is cultural association, not a claim of an exclusive or complete diet.
Ștecher, prelungitor and cablu connect electrical supply. Robinet regulates fluid; all are household objects but only one fails the functional predicate.
Foame, sete and oboseală signal bodily needs. Rușine is a social emotion; all four are states, avoiding a mere object-versus-person shortcut.
Bunică, bunic and mătușă name relatives. Coleg names a work or school relation; an individual being both does not change the lexical distinction.
Eye/seeing, bedroom/bed, detergent/dish sponge and Popescu/Arșinel have distinct ordinary links. The comedy partnership needs no adult joke to be recognized.
Ear/hearing, cable/extension lead, ship/port and poem/Eminescu are separate links. The electrical part-whole wording is honest and the poem attribution is inherited factual evidence.
Rainbow/colour, calendar/day, Peleș/Sinaia and flour/cozonac are specific recognizable links. Calendar is not mislabelled meteorology, and flour has only one prepared-food partner here.
Gară, aeroport and stație are transport stopping places. Vapor is a vehicle; the ordinary transport sense of stație is supported by all four options.
A mânca, a bea and a găti concern food or drink consumption/preparation. A citi does not acquire that meaning merely from reading recipes; drinking is neutrally framed.
Vânt, nor and ceață are atmospheric phenomena; noapte is a time interval. Weather occurring at night does not make night itself weather.
Banană, portocală and lămâie are edible fruits, while morcov is a root. The label correctly avoids calling all three citrus fruits.
Grape/raisins, soil/shovel, pavement/street and neck/head have concrete distinct relationships. Plant and outdoor associations do not yield a second full solution.
Biscuit/crumb, chair/stool, week/weekend and ciorbă/bowl are accessible. Part-whole and serving relationships remain specific rather than a vague household grouping.
Night/sleep, fridge/freezer, mouth/lip and garment/lint each have an ordinary anchor. Sleep is associated with night without being restricted to it.
Garden/rake, carpet/vacuum, mother/baby and wolf/forest are distinct familiar links. Habitat is not claimed exclusive, and incidental garden animals do not complete an alternative pairing.
Pat, saltea and pernă are intended for sleep. Scaun is intended for sitting; possible naps do not erase the ordinary functional distinction.
Făină, mălai and griș result from cereal milling. Drojdie is a fermentation agent, preserving a clear same-domain outsider.
Cameră, sufragerie and dormitor name interior rooms; curte is outdoors. Both everyday senses of sufragerie remain within the stated predicate.
Caiet, creion and pix are writing supplies; examen is an assessment rather than stationery. Written examinations do not provide a competing lexical answer.
Homework/notebook, tiredness/sleep, nail/pliers and oil/sunflower seeds are specific links. The oil relation is a familiar source, not a claim about every oil.
Forehead/eyebrow, pot/stove, goat/grass and calendar/month are distinct everyday relations. The goat's food is not presented as its exclusive diet.
Open/close, vanilla filling/cremșnit, plate/dish sponge and hand/finger separate clearly. The opposition and part-whole relation prevent an interchangeable household pairing.
Mouth/speaking, sugar/powdered sugar, milk/whey and hose/watering can have specific meanings. Food associations cannot exchange the two ingredient-process pairs coherently.
Ciocan, clește and șurubelniță are workshop tools; burete de vase is for cleaning. Two members recur from an older trio, but the complete trio is distinct and no new novelty credit is claimed.
Mână, deget and picior are body parts; cămașă is clothing. The wider label avoids incorrectly asserting that a finger is itself an entire limb.
Farfurie, castron and cană serve food or drink at the table. Găleată is a utility container; the shared container type does not resolve the board by itself.
Găleată, mop and detergent participate in floor washing. Lampă illuminates rather than washes; the label honestly includes both objects and a cleaning product.
Thirst/water, wheelbarrow/garden, pen/schoolbag and son/daughter are coherent. Water/garden is incidental but leaves thirst without a partner, so it is not another full solution.
Hunger/food, saw/tree, dog/yard and blanket/sheet are recognizable. Food/dog leaves hunger unmatched; yard is a possible guarded space rather than every dog's home.
Leg/ankle, Sun/star, writing/notebook and jacket/wardrobe have exact ordinary anchors. The Sun is correctly a star and picior uses the usual lower-limb sense.
Moon/night, butter/biscuit salami, citrus fruits and tooth/toothpaste are distinct. Moon visibility and dessert ingredients are associations or documented variants, not universal exclusivity claims.
Furtună, fulger and tunet are atmospheric phenomena; Lună is a celestial body. The predicate does not require every storm to have thunder.
Leaf/branch, dog/cat, banana/fruit and wheat/flour have recognizable relations. Plant-food overlap does not create another complete matching or imply all flour is wheat flour.
Frate, soră and unchi name relatives; vecini names nearby residents. Ordinary meanings resolve the board without relying on figurative or religious uses.
Wall/ceiling, metro/tram, cooking/kitchen and exam/lesson are clear relations. The school link does not require every lesson to end in an exam; no competing complete matching emerges.
